question: Can the M-TARE global-planning replacement boundary and an underground benchmark proposal be supported by traceable source/log evidence without running simulation?
method: Read-only cross-audit of source, launch files, scripts, world assets, protocols, and historical logs; every contract field is marked VERIFIED, PARTIAL, UNVERIFIED, or CONFLICT with evidence paths.
baseline: Original M-TARE global planner; historical runs are reusable only when world/start/seed/runtime/motion/log validity can be reconstructed.

user_authorization.scope: Perform the Gate-0 read-only interface and benchmark audit, create draft contracts and a baseline rerun proposal, and run CPU-only validators; do not start ROS, simulation, data export, annotation, or training.

acceptance_criteria: The replacement boundary states exactly which M-TARE modules are retained and which global-planning responsibilities are replaced.
Each interface topic/frame/type/rate/owner field has a status and evidence path; unknown values remain UNVERIFIED rather than guessed.
Every candidate world has underground relevance, asset provenance, historical-exposure status, and eligibility for development or strict test.
The proposal contains at least three development-world candidates and identifies whether two genuinely clean strict-test worlds exist.
Historical baseline runs are classified VALID_CANDIDATE, INVALID, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and missing reruns are enumerated.
No ROS, simulator, annotation, data export, teacher generation, or model training command runs.
expected_evidence: Human-readable Gate-0 interface and benchmark proposal
Machine-readable interface contract draft and evidence index
Benchmark proposal and baseline rerun matrix
Schema validator, tests, logs, and task summary

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only source/log inspection and JSON validation; no ROS or simulator
